text:
alex j: Heads-up — Hubris wants to run a short POC using a custom model adapter they built. They expect ~250 qps, mostly short prompts (avg 120 tokens). Need to confirm model fit, adapter memory, KMS flow, and an initial pricing estimate for a 2-week trial.

maria se: Got it. Do we have the adapter artifact? Any special ops requirements (shared lib, CUDA version)?

alex j: They sent a tar.gz with a wheel and a small C++ extension. Says it targets CUDA 12 and links to cuBLAS. I'll paste the manifest in a sec.

ryan se: Can we run that on Dedicated or do we need Private? C++ extension + KMS for key unwrap might push them to Private.

alex j: Manifest snippet:
```
name: hubris_adapter
cuda: 12
deps: []
native: true
config:
  max_seq: 4096
  kv_cache_mb: 14000
  quant: q4_0
```

sophie sec: KMS flow: they want HW HSM-backed unwrap. Our hosted plan uses cloud KMS; Dedicated supports customer KMS via IAM. Private is only option for HSM. We need to flag this as a security blocker.

maria se: From ops side, that kv_cache_mb looks high for a single model. If we use batch size tuning and prefix caching we might fit into a 48GB GPU for short sequences. But the native extension complicates our runtime sandboxing.

infra-bot: deploy-check: native extensions require containerization + CVE scan. Policy: blocked on hosted unless binary signed + CVE report.

ryan se: Action items — (1) ask Hubris for signed binary and CVE report; (2) run quick memory smoke on Dedicated dev pool (I'll schedule); (3) propose pricing: hosted-like estimate = $X/day token + adapter surcharge; Dedicated 2-week trial estimate = $Y flat + usage.

alex j: I'll request signed binary + HSM requirement confirmation and share the pile tonight. If they insist on HSM we'll move to Private sales track. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
